objective: Replace the tabletop two-link visual concept with a truthful mobile domestic manipulator architecture: one seven-axis collaborative arm, a braked lifting platform, stabilized mobile base, tool changing, and bounded parcel, cleaning, and induction-cooking assistance.
acceptance: Revision C declares seven revolute arm joints with limits and planning torque classes
the lifting platform has controlled travel, brakes, mechanical locks, hard limits, and pinch detection
the mobile base declares driving and deployed stabilization footprints and uses low-mounted ballast
SCAD and CadQuery sources depict seven coherent joints, a telescopic lift, hidden wheels, and tool quick-change
parcel, cleaning, and cooking-assistance claims remain target capabilities pending physical validation
the main product visual removes floating parts, exposed wheels, decorative rods, and unsupported payload claims
mechanical package tests and Task Packet validation pass
stop_conditions: a change requires robot control, firmware, interfaces, or PCB ownership
a visual implies autonomous open-flame cooking, stair traversal, person lifting, or proven physical performance
motion or thermal safety evidence would need to be invented
the generated CAD cannot preserve declared lift, arm, tool, or support datums
